MEDICC2 input table (MEDICC2 export, step 3)

Source: R/medicc2.R
medicc2_table.Rd

One row per sample x segment with integer copy numbers capped at cap: sample_id, chrom, start, end, cn_a, cn_b (allele-specific) or sample_id, chrom, start, end, cn (total = cn_a + cn_b, for --total-copy-numbers --input-allele-columns cn). Adjacent pieces of a chromosome whose values are identical in every sample are merged (after the cap; on cn_a / cn_b, or on cn for the total table), so every sample has the same segments, as MEDICC2 requires. The normal clone normal is a sample (MEDICC2 --normal-name N0); when absent it is added as 1:1 on diploid and 1:0 on haploid pieces (male chrX), so it is the root of the tree. Chromosomes are sorted naturally.

Usage

medicc2_table(
  x,
  allele_specific = TRUE,
  normal = "N0",
  cap = 8L,
  chroms = paste0("chr", c(1:22, "X"))
)

Arguments

x

orient_clone_states() result, or a long table with clone, chrom, start, end, cn_a, cn_b (+ ploidy)

allele_specific

TRUE: cn_a / cn_b columns; FALSE: total cn

normal

name of the normal sample

cap

maximal copy number (MEDICC2 caps at 8)

chroms

chromosomes kept

Value

data.table (MEDICC2 TSV layout); attribute n_pieces (pieces before merging)
